## Operator control notes

Before release, verify:

- document is eligible for the selected apostille/authentication authority
- notarial certificate / public-record certification is complete when required
- signer / subject name matches the final Matter record
- destination country is correct
- document count is correct
- government fee is verified from the current authority source
- return label / courier method is valid
- custody event is recorded

The historic one-document Italy letter is a completed Matter example only; this template is the reusable production form.
